title: The oz/grams button is a pain in the tail!!!
text: The oz/grams button is a pain in the tail!!!. Does it work... absolutely.  Is it well-designed... not so much.  The grams/oz button is on the bottom of the appliance.  Meaning you put your food on.  Then suddenly found out your nutritional information is in ounces and not grams.  you have to pick up whole machine, manage not to spill your food, find the TINY switch.  May sound small but its really a PAIN!!!  Spend a couple extra bucks and get one that has the button on the side or front or more user friendly location.

product_metadata.title: MyFine MF-2K810S 2kg Kitchen Food Scale
description: Keep track of what you are eating with this easy to use, versatile kitchen scale. It has a stainless steel finish with a back-lit LCD display. It weights in both grams (g) and ounces (oz).
